newsitem.title: USA: U.S spot propane stable, market digests mild temps.
newsitem.headline: U.S spot propane stable, market digests mild temps.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were stable in terribly thin talk Friday with the market apparently done digesting the mild weather sweeping through the midcontinent that has dampened demand in the region.
"The (current) five-day forecast is just horrible," said one trader in Texas, referring to the way the weather has backed up supplies at the Mount Belvieu, Texas hub.

To make matters worse, players said the liquified petroleum gas (lpg) tanker market is tight now, which means supplies languoring in Texas have limited opportunity to get a piece of propane's weather-driven action in Europe.
The flagging demand was seen by some traders as reason for TET to lift its allocation program at Mount Belvieu, but that has not yet happened.
Propane in Mount Belvieu stood at between 49 and 49.50 cents a gallon, compared to about 66 cents a gallon in the midcontinent hub at Conway, Kansas.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
